title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕ Thursday, September 3, 2026

🌤️ Weather — ~68°F and cloudy, high of 84°F (low 71°F). Warm and a touch muggy, low rain chance. Short sleeves by midday, maybe shades.

🗞️ Headlines
• Maduro and wife ask a judge to toss their US drug-trafficking indictment, claiming head-of-state immunity.
• NBA suspends Clippers owner Steve Ballmer 1 year, fines team $30M over cap circumvention tied to Kawhi Leonard.
• Minneapolis reeling after a deadly shooting near Loring Park — 3 dead, several injured.
• Vance Boelter pleads not guilty to first-degree murder in the 2025 killing of MN House Speaker Melissa Hortman.

🚇 Getting around — Mostly normal. From Fri night: Church Av-bound G trains skip 4 Av-9 St, 15 St-Prospect Park & Fort Hamilton Pkwy through Labor Day.

🎉 NYC today — Lily Allen performs West End Girl at MSG, 8pm. Sylvan Esso DJ at Elsewhere (10pm).

💡 Nugget — Last stretch before Labor Day: historically one of the cheapest weekends for last-minute NYC hotel & Broadway deals.
